title: iOverlander Camp Spot Event Rating Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ioverlander:place rating_score=*
| stats sum(rating_score) as total_value, avg(rating_score) as avg_value by place_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks place name values by total and average rating score across iOverlander camp spot event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rating_score` values for each iOverlander camp spot event event and review total and average rating score by place name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rating score.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which place name shows the biggest rating score numbers in your iOverlander camp spot event data.
